The male voice continues, joined by the high-pitched, enthusiastic voices of a young boy and girl reacting to the contents. The boy's voice rises in arousal as he identifies the basketball-themed item, while the BGM maintains its steady rhythmic pattern. It highlights the excitement of the children and the father's evaluation of the products, which include stationery and NBA-branded items, while maintaining a casual, domestic atmosphere.
